problem_statement: NVS startup fails to mount a sector that becomes logically full due to a power loss during the last ATE write. When the data write area fills up to the point where no erased space remains for further data writes (data_wra catches up with the ATE write address), startup treats this as an error and nvs_mount() returns a failure, even though the sector is merely full and should be closed and garbage-collected on the next write. nvs_mount() must succeed in this situation, and the next write must succeed by triggering garbage collection.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/fs/nvs -s tests/subsys/fs/nvs/filesystem.nvs -s filesystem.nvs -O twister-out --no-clean -W
